name: Miseki Ruriiro
source: The protagonist of the story, a third-year high school boy who attends a school in Tokyo. Like his [url=/c155146]younger sister[/url], he was born with albinism, but pigment remains in his eyes, correcting them to dark blue. He used to live his life a step back from his sister, but after being invited to a movie shoot, his transparent life began to change――.
translation: The protagonist of the story, a third-year high school boy who attends a school in Tokyo. Like his [url=/c155146]younger sister[/url], he was born with albinism, but pigment remains in his eyes, correcting them to dark blue. He used to live his life a step back from his sister, but after being invited to a movie shoot, his transparent life began to change――.
